name: National University of Singapore
overview: Singapore's oldest autonomous university and consistently its highest ranked, teaching entirely in English across medicine, law, computing, engineering, business and the sciences.

name: Nanyang Technological University
overview: A research-intensive autonomous university organised around colleges of Engineering, Business, Computing and Data Science, Science, Medicine, and Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences.

name: Singapore Management University
overview: A city-campus university specialising in business, accountancy, economics, law, computing and social sciences, taught in a seminar-based format.

name: King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals
overview: Saudi Arabia's leading science and engineering university, with particular strength in petroleum engineering, computing, artificial intelligence and cybersecurity. Graduate study is commonly fully funded.

name: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
overview: A graduate-only research university on the Red Sea coast. Every admitted student receives a fellowship covering tuition, housing, medical cover and a living allowance; there is no separate scholarship application.

name: King Saud University
overview: The kingdom's oldest and largest public university, offering medicine, engineering, business and the sciences, with dedicated application portals for international students.

name: King Abdulaziz University
overview: A large public university in Jeddah covering sciences, engineering, business, medicine and Islamic studies, and one of the institutions reachable through the national scholarship portal.

name: Complutense University of Madrid
overview: One of Spain's largest and oldest public universities, offering a very broad catalogue across the humanities, sciences, health and social sciences.

name: University of Barcelona
overview: Catalonia's principal public research university and regularly Spain's highest placed institution in international rankings.

name: Universidad Carlos III de Madrid
overview: A younger Madrid public university with an unusually large English-taught catalogue in engineering, economics, business and social sciences.

name: Pompeu Fabra University
overview: A compact, research-intensive public university in Barcelona, strongest in economics, political science, communication and biomedicine.

name: Middle East Technical University
overview: Türkiye's foremost English-medium technical university, teaching engineering, architecture, natural sciences and economics entirely in English.

name: Bogazici University
overview: An English-medium public university on the Bosphorus, descended from Robert College and consistently among Türkiye's most selective institutions.

name: Istanbul Technical University
overview: One of the world's oldest technical universities, offering engineering, architecture, maritime studies and computing with a substantial English-taught catalogue.

name: Koc University
overview: A private, English-medium research university in Istanbul with strong provision in engineering, business, medicine and the social sciences, and a substantial merit scholarship programme.

name: University of Vienna
overview: The oldest university in the German-speaking world and Austria's largest, with a very wide subject range and a growing English-taught master's catalogue.

name: TU Wien
overview: Vienna's technical university, focused on engineering, informatics, architecture and the natural sciences.

name: University of Innsbruck
overview: A public research university in the Tyrol, strong in the natural sciences, geosciences and mountain research.

name: Graz University of Technology
overview: A technical university in Graz covering engineering, computer science, and advanced materials, with research partnerships across Austrian industry.

name: Johannes Kepler University Linz
overview: A public university in Linz offering law, business, engineering, computer science and medicine on a single campus.
